correctness.rationale: Normalizing the spectrum to \((1,s,0)\), the exact cycle map is \(T_i(p)=p_i|\mu-\beta_i|^4/Z\). The middle coordinate and the two extreme ratios for a reversal pair imply \(\mu'=1-\mu\), while \(\mu+\mu'=1+(2s-1)p_2\); full support forces \(s=1/2\). The remaining equations give exactly the two stated \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)\) weight states. Direct multiplication of the two cycle factors yields the common radial factor. The inspected exact verifier was independently replayed and confirms the two-state swap, common normalization \(Z=1/64\), positivity, and the \((3,2,1)\) specialization \(1/49\).

final_claim: For cyclic steepest descent with cycle length two and exactly three active eigenvalues, a full-support projective two-cycle that reverses the extreme spectral weights exists exactly for an arithmetic-progression spectrum; its two weight states are uniquely \((3/8\pm\sqrt2/4,1/4,3/8\mp\sqrt2/4)\), and its four-update radial factor is \((\kappa-1)^4/(\kappa^2+6\kappa+1)^2\).
limitations: Necessity is only within the explicitly defined reversal-symmetric full-support projective two-cycle class.
Other exceptional or periodic CSD orbits are not classified.
